ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE HITCHING POST URBAN RENEWAL
PLAN AND THE HITCHING POST URBAN RENEWAL PROJECT
PURSUANT TO WYOMING STATUTE15-9-110, AND APPROVING THE
CREATION OF A NEW HITCHING POST URBAN RENEWAL AUTHORITY
FIDUCIARY FUND."
WHEREAS, pursuant to Resolution No.6156 and under Wyoming Statute15-9-101, et
seq., the City of Cheyenne found certain areas tobe appropriate for an urban renewal project,
including the“Hitching Post Study Area”as described in Resolution 6156; and
WHEREAS, Resolution No.6156was adopted after hearings on June14,2021 and June
28,2021 and in conformity with Wyoming Statute15-9-106; and
WHEREAS, Wyoming StatuteS15-9-108requires that before approving an urban renewal
project, the Governing Body shall have submitted the applicable urban renewal plan to the City
Planning Commission, for review and recommendations as to its conformity with Plan Cheyenne,
whichis the general planforthe development of the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, on August 2,2021, the City Planning Commission:(i) reviewed the Hitching
Post Urban Renewal Plan for the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Project, (i) found the Hitching
Post Urban Renewal Plantobe in conformity with Plan Cheyenne, and (i)recommended that the
Governing Body adopt the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan for the Hitching Post Urban
Renewal Project[with proposed changes to the plan as have been reported to the Governing Body
/ in the form presented to the Planning Commission]; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body held a public hearing on the Hitching Post Urban
Renewal Plan and Project in accordance with Wyoming Statute & 15-9-109(a); and
WHEREAS, on July 27,2021, notice of the public hearing required by Wyoming Statute
 15-9-109(a) was mailed to all property owners; and
WHEREAS, on August 2, 2021, notice of the public hearing was mailed to all affected
taxing agencies; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body has reviewed the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan and
Hitching Post Urban Renewal Project, and, for the reasons set forth in such plan is able to make,
and herebymakes, the following findings:
(i)The Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan conforms to Plan Cheyenne, and is
traffic, public transportation, public utilities, recreational and community facilities
and other public improvements; and
(ii)
The Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan is sufficiently complete to indicate land
acquisition, demolition and removal of structures, redevelopment, improvements,

zoning and planning changes, if any, land used, maximum densities and building

WHEREAS, the Governing Body has reviewed the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan and
Hitching Post Urban Renewal Project, and, for the reasons set forth in such plan is able to make,
and hereby makes, the following findings:
(i)
Because the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan and project area boundaries do not
encompass any residential properties, there is no need todesignate a method for
relocation of families displaced from the urban renewal area;
(ii)
The Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan conforms to Plan Cheyenne as a whole;
(ii)
The Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan gives due consideration to the provision of
adequate park and recreational areas and facilities that may be desirable for
neighborhood improvement, with special consideration for thehealth, safety and
welfare of children residing in the general vicinity of the site covered by the
Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan;
(iv)
The Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan affords maximum opportunity, consistent
with the municipality's needs, for the rehabilitation or redevelopment of the urban
renewal area by private enterprise; and
WHEREAS, approval of the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan and Project authorizes
division of property taxes pursuant to Wyoming Statute & 15-9-120; and
WHEREAS, division of property taxes shall be collected and deposited into a newly
created Hitching Post Urban Renewal Authority Fiduciary Fund and segregated for the
purpose of the Urban Renewal Authority.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
hereby approves the Hitching Post Urban Renewal Plan and Hitching Post Urban Renewal Project
and the creation of a new Hitching Post Urban Renewal Authority Fiduciary Fund.
